title: Intune Compliance-Failure Diagnostics & Remediation
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Know exactly why a device is non-compliant — before it loses access
problem: A device flips to non-compliant, Conditional Access blocks the user, and the help desk can't say which setting failed or why. This toolkit gives you a root-cause method and scripts to read the exact per-setting failure, understand evaluation timing and grace periods, and see the Conditional Access blast radius — then remediate safely, without disabling policy fleet-wide.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how compliance evaluation works (policy → per-setting state → grace → CA gate), where results surface, and the model behind the diagnostic tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need (Intune roles, Graph read access, device access) with how to verify each.
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (which setting failed, evaluation lag, grace expiry, built-in vs custom rule, CA block) with the exact checks per branch.
5 PowerShell scripts — compliance-state discovery, per-device per-setting failure validation, a fleet compliance + CA-impact report, safe remediation of common failures, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (setting passes, device compliant, CA allows), plus Best Practices for grace and staged enforcement.
short: A root-cause method and scripts to read the exact per-setting compliance failure, evaluation timing, grace, and the Conditional Access blast radius — then remediate safely. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A root-cause method and scripts to read the exact per-setting compliance failure, evaluation timing, grace, and the Conditional Access blast radius — then remediate safely.
meta_description: Diagnose Intune device compliance failures: per-setting failure reasons, evaluation timing, grace periods, Conditional Access impact, and safe remediation. Self-guided root-cause tree and PowerShell scripts.
bottom_line: Every non-compliant device explained to the exact failing setting — with the Conditional Access impact and a safe fix — using a repeatable method you keep and reuse.
